caption: Adjusted Metric
description: The Adjusted Metric object describes a single CVSS environmental metric modification applied by a security product, including the metric that was changed and the reason for the change.
name: adjusted_metric

cvss_metric.description: The CVSS environmental metric that was modified. Values correspond to CVSS v3.x/v4.0 environmental metric abbreviations (e.g. MAV, MAC, MPR, MUI, MS, MC, MI, MA).

update_reason.description: The reason the CVSS metric was modified (e.g. There is no path from the internet to this instance).
